mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Baleful Strike Power</titleLeft><mainText>Veigar has gained @f1@ Ability Power.</mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Unleashes dark energy at target enemy, dealing magic damage. If a unit is killed, Veigar gains some Ability Power permanently.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Active: Veigar unleashes dark energy at target enemy, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage. If the target is killed, Veigar gains @APPerStack@ Ability Power. This bonus is doubled against Champions, large minions and large monsters.

Passive: Veigar gains @APPerKill@ Ability Power when he kills a champion from any source of damage.

Bonus Ability Power: +@f1@

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Stunned</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is stunned. It can take no actions.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Stunned</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is stunned. It can take no actions.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Veigar's mana regeneration increases by 1% for each 1% of mana missing.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Veigar's <scaleMana>mana regeneration</scaleMana> increases by 1% for each 1% of mana missing.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Unleashes dark energy at target enemy, dealing magic damage. If a unit is killed, Veigar gains some Ability Power permanently.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Active: Veigar unleashes dark energy at target enemy, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage. If the target is killed, Veigar gains @APPerStack@ Ability Power. This bonus is doubled against Champions, large minions and large monsters.

Passive: Veigar gains @APPerKill@ Ability Power when he kills a champion from any source of damage.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Veigar calls a great mass of dark matter to fall from the sky to the target location, dealing magic damage when it lands.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <mainText>After 1.2 seconds, dark matter falls from the sky to the target location, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.</mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Veigar twists the edges of space around the target location for 3 seconds, stunning enemies who pass through the perimeter for a short duration.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <mainText>Veigar twists the edges of space around the target location for 3 seconds, <status>Stunning</status> enemies who pass through the perimeter for @StunDuration@ seconds.</mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Blasts target enemy champion, dealing a large base amount of magic damage plus 80% of his target's AP.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <mainText>Blasts an enemy champion, dealing <magicDamage>@MinDamage@ plus 80% of his target's Ability Power in magic damage</magicDamage>.</mainText>
